target_device: nvme0n1 (bare-metal ROOT disk, rootfs /dev/nvme0n1p2; coefficients measured through the file-backed path)

provenance.mode_note: kvmhost used --testdev (exclusive disk, destructive writes to /dev/sdb); bm FORBIDS raw-device writes (root disk), so the tool ran in its testfile mode against a file on the root filesystem -- the same nvme0n1 device the campaign workloads use. elevator/nomerges were temporarily set by the tool and restored (verified post-probe).
provenance.pv_shim_note: pv absent on bm; a pass-through shim was used during the probe
provenance.qos_predeclare_note: QOS predeclared, identical structure/percentages as the kvmhost contract and the m2 fig2 io_cost arms (rpct/wpct=95, rlat/wlat=20000us, min=50 max=150): consistency across figures, not tuned.
